name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9.6-dev.18 (model dev build for Osama): dev.17 plus the Type 100 CSV fix: one four-way loadout slot (40 mm CT, 40 mm CT + GL-5 APS, 9x CH-901, 9x CH-901 + GL-5 APS) and separate transport rows so the infantry transports no longer share the recon card units. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.91.
